announcements.text: Clark Construction Group LLC, Bethesda, Maryland, was awarded a $117,787,000 firm-fixed-price contract to construct unaccompanied enlisted personnel housing barracks and associated support spaces. Bids were solicited via the internet with eight received. Work will be performed in Fort Myer, Virginia, with an estimated completion date of Oct. 18, 2030. Fiscal 2026 military construction, Army funds in the amount of $117,787,000 were obligated at the time of award. Army Corps of Engineers, Baltimore, Maryland, is the contracting activity (W912DR-26-C-A015).

Walsh Federal LLC, Chicago, Illinois, was awarded a $73,749,000 firm-fixed-price contract with a total cumulative face value of $80,914,000, for construction of a secure operations facility. Bids were solicited via the internet with three received. Work will be performed in Joint Base Lewis-McChord, Washington, with an estimated completion date of Jan. 12, 2029. Fiscal 2010 military construction, Army funds in the amount of $73,749,000 were obligated at the time of award. Army Corps of Engineers, Seattle, Washington, is the contracting activity (W912DW-26-C-A035).

Great Lakes Dredge & Dock Co. LLC., Houston, Texas, was awarded a $28,460,000 firm-fixed-price contract for the Fiscal 2027 South Atlantic Division regional harbor dredge program, with a total cumulative face value of $29,928,000. Bids were solicited via the internet with three received. Work will be performed in Brunswick and Savannah, Georgia, and Wilmington, North Carolina, with an estimated completion date of April 15, 2027. Fiscal 2024, 2025 and 2026 civil works funds in the amount of $28,460,000 were obligated at the time of award. Army Corps of Engineers, Wilmington, North Carolina, is the contracting activity (W912PM-26-C-A019).

Limno-Tech Inc.,* Ann Arbor, Michigan (W912HQ-26-D-A004); Research Triangle Institute, Durham, North Carolina (W912HQ-26-D-A005); Resource Management Associates, Davis, California (W912HQ-26-D-A006); and WSP USA Environment & Infrastructure Inc, Blue Bell, Pennsylvania (W912HQ-26-D-A007), will compete for each order of the $26,237,065 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for water resources engineering and planning software development, water resources data, methodologies, tools and models, training services, analyses, assessments, and studies. Bids were solicited via the internet with five received. Work locations and funding will be determined with each order, with an estimated completion date of Sept. 19, 2031. Army Corps of Engineers' Humphreys Engineer Center Support Activity, Fort Belvoir, Virginia, is the contracting activity.

CORRECTION: The $20,000,000 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract (W9128Z-26-D-A014) announced on Sept. 11, 2026, to Onebrief Inc., Honolulu, Hawaii, for commercial software platforms, actually has an estimated completion date of Sept. 10, 2031.

CORRECTION: The $19,999,798 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract (W519TC-26-F-A562) announced on Sept. 11, 2026, to Northrop Grumman Systems Corp., Radford, Virginia, for non-standard ammunition, was not actually awarded.

Akima Facilities Operations LLC, Herndon, Virginia, was awarded a $17,927,838 modification (P00154) to contract W52P1J-20-F-0137 for induction and repair of military equipment in support of the conversion of a cavalry regiment to a heavy brigade combat team configuration. One bid was solicited with one received. Work locations and funding will be determined with each order, with an estimated completion date of Oct. 18, 2027. Army Contracting Command, Rock Island, Illinois, is the contracting activity.

Northrop Grumman Systems Corp., Woodland Hills, California, is awarded a $34,388,301 modification (P00005) to a firm-fixed-price indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract (N0001924D0123). This modification increases the ceiling of an existing contract for potential to procure additional UH-1Y and AH-1Z Helicopter Link-16 A-Kits, B-Kits, and associated Spare Parts. Specifically, the contract quantities are increased by (8) UH-1Y Link 16 A Kits, (9) AH-1Z Link 16 A Kits, (17) Link 16 B Kits, and Spare Parts including Systems Engineering/Program Management and Logistics Support. Work will be performed in Chicago, Illinois (23%), Woodland Hills, California (22%), Salt Lake City, Utah (20%), San Diego, California (9%), Rancho Cucamonga, California (8%), Huntsville, Alabama (8%), Dallas, Texas (5%), Scottsdale, Arizona (2%), Rochester, New York (1%), and Other Localities below 1% (2%), and is expected to be completed by March 2027. No funds will be obligated at the time of award; funds will be obligated on individual orders as they are issued. This contract was not competed. Naval Air Systems Command, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity.

Dove Medical Supply LLC.,** Summerfield, North Carolina, (SPE2DF-26-D-0019, $330,000,000) has been added as an awardee to the multiple award contract for laboratory equipment, accessories, and consumables for the Defense Logistics Agency Electronic Catalog, issued against solicitation SPE2DE-22-R-0006 and awarded Feb. 24, 2023. The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Troop Support, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

UPDATE: American Material Handling Inc.,* Watkinsville, Georgia (SPE8EC-26-D-0025, $86,000,000) has been added as an awardee to the multiple award contract for agricultural equipment, issued against solicitation SPE8EC-21-R-0006 and awarded July 29, 2022. The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Troop Support, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

Collins Engine Nozzles Inc., West Des Moines, Iowa, has been awarded an estimated $77,967,014 firm-fixed-price, one-time buy contract for J-85 fuel injection nozzle manufacture. This was a sole-source acquisition using justification 10 U.S. Code 3204 (a)(1), as stated in Federal Acquisition Regulation 6.302-1. The performance completion date is Jan. 31, 2032. Using military service is Air Force. Type of appropriation is fiscal 2026 defense working capital funds. The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Weapons Support, Tinker AFB, Oklahoma (SPRTA1-26-C-0092).

Collins Engine Nozzles Inc., West Des Moines, Iowa, has been awarded a maximum $70,290,396 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for J-85 engine main spray bars. This was a sole-source acquisition using justification 10 U.S. Code 3204 (c)(1), as stated in Federal Acquisition Regulation 6.302-1. This is a three-year contract with no option periods. The ordering period end date is Sept. 14, 2029. Using military service is Air Force. Type of appropriation is fiscal 2026 through 2029 defense working capital funds. The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Weapons Support, Tinker AFB, Oklahoma (SPRTA1-26-D-0008).

Kandor Manufacturing Inc.,*** Arecibo, Puerto Rico, has been awarded a maximum $57,004,800 modification (P00030) exercising the fourth one‐year option period of a one‐year base contract (SPE1C1‐23‐D‐0008) with four one‐year option periods for various types of coats and trousers. This is a firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract. The ordering period end date is Oct. 8, 2027. Using military services are Army, Air Force and Space Force. Type of appropriation is fiscal 2026 through 2027 defense working capital funds. The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Troop Support, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

Elegant Stitches Inc.,* Pittsfield, Massachusetts, has been awarded a maximum $35,738,199 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for Army Green Service Uniform dress shirts. This was a competitive acquisition with seven responses received. This is a five-year contract with no option periods. The location of performance is Puerto Rico, with a Sept. 14, 2031, ordering period completion date. Using military service is Army. Type of appropriation is fiscal 2026 through 2031 defense working capital funds. The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Troop Support, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania (SPE1C1-26-D-0091).

Robertson Fuel Systems, Tempe, Arizona, has been awarded a maximum $18,636,940 firm-fixed-price delivery order (SPRPA1-26-F-N903) issued against a five-year basic ordering agreement (N00383-25-G-N901) for V-22 aircraft tank assembly spare parts. This was a sole-source acquisition using justification 10 U.S. Code 3204 (c)(1), as stated in Federal Acquisition Regulation 6.302-1. This is a three-year contract with no option periods. The performance completion date is Nov. 16, 2029. The using military service is Navy. Type of appropriation is fiscal 2026 Navy working capital funds. The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Weapons Support, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.
